title: Collision Course
tagline: Where the law and the street meet head-on, Detective Lt. Josh Williams has to pick a lane.
description: After a police sergeant’s fatal encounter with a troubled Marine veteran, an ambitious prosecutor sees a chance to advance his political career. Detective Lieutenant Josh Williams has to follow the evidence as the case becomes a fight over who gets to tell the story.

title: Silenced Justice
tagline: When the system goes quiet, someone has to keep talking. Josh Williams won’t let it rest.
description: Detective Lieutenant Josh Williams takes a fresh look at a 1972 case after a former colleague asks for help. A man died behind bars before his innocence could be established, and following the evidence exposes a conspiracy that reaches well beyond the original investigation.

title: Pieces of the Past
tagline: A 1970s cold case comes back, and some of what was buried with it comes back too.
description: Human remains found at an abandoned construction site send Detective Lieutenant Josh Williams back to a kidnapping from the 1970s. What begins as a review of an old case becomes a live investigation as new evidence meets scarce resources and political pressure.

title: Buried Verdicts
tagline: Listed in Joe’s official bibliography as a Josh Williams novel.
description: Listed in Joe’s official bibliography as a Josh Williams novel.

title: Improbable Cause
tagline: Listed in Joe’s official bibliography as a Josh Williams novel.
description: Listed in Joe’s official bibliography as a Josh Williams novel.

title: A Change of Hate
tagline: A former Green Beret turned defense lawyer takes a case built on a Buddhist monk’s secrets.
description: Harrison “Hawk” Bennett is a former Green Beret turned defense attorney. When he represents a Buddhist monk accused of murder, memories of Vietnam draw him toward a conspiracy and a colonel he thought he had killed.

title: It’s Just the Way It Was
tagline: Inside the war on the New England mob.
description: Joe Broadmeadow and former Rhode Island State Police superintendent Brendan Doherty recount the investigations, surveillance and work with informants that went into the fight against organized crime in New England.
subtitle: Inside the War on the New England Mob

title: Choices
tagline: A life on the other side of the law, told without excuses.
description: Jerry Tillinghast recounts his life in his own words, from growing up in Providence and serving as a Marine in Vietnam to his years in the orbit of the New England mob. He describes what those choices cost him and his family.
subtitle: You Make ’em, You Own ’em

title: UnMade
tagline: What it costs to walk away from the life.
description: Bobby Walason describes surviving on the streets as a child, going to prison as a teenager and becoming a New England mob enforcer. Written with Joe Broadmeadow, his account follows the choices that eventually let him leave that life.
subtitle: Honor, Loyalty, Redemption

title: Divine Providence
subtitle: The Mayor, the Mob, and the Man in the Middle
tagline: One man saw the worlds of Buddy Cianci and Raymond Patriarca from the inside.
description: Joe Broadmeadow and Pat Cortellessa trace the overlapping worlds of Providence mayor Buddy Cianci and mob boss Raymond Patriarca through the experience of Cortellessa, who knew both circles firsthand.

title: Saving the Last Dragon
tagline: The last of a kind that was supposed to be legend.
description: Duncan Emeris starts writing a story about dragons for school. When the dragons in his dreams turn out to be real, he and his friends are drawn into the search for the last dragon egg.

title: Raising the Last Dragon
tagline: Now it has to grow up.
description: In the sequel to Saving the Last Dragon, Duncan Emeris and his friends must protect the last dragon’s eggs from people determined to destroy them.

title: Defending the Last Dragon
tagline: The final book in the trilogy.
description: Joe announced the final installment in The Last Dragon trilogy in his April 2026 author dispatch.

title: Spirit of the Trail
description: Inspired by Joe Broadmeadow’s 2,185-mile Appalachian Trail thru-hike, this short story follows two hikers who meet on the trail and take the first miles together.
subtitle: 2,185 Miles on the Appalachian Trail

title: Flap Flap
tagline: Listed in Joe’s official bibliography as a picture book titled Flap Flap: The Silliest Dragon.
description: Listed in Joe’s official bibliography as a picture book titled Flap Flap: The Silliest Dragon.
subtitle: The Silliest Dragon

title: Thauma
tagline: A small bedtime story about wonder.
description: In Joe’s story about childhood wonder, four-year-old Levi discovers Thauma in the quiet space under the stairs.
